findings.impact: The durable progress receipt still records independent structured review as NOT_RUN, while four committed round-one reviews returned NOT_CLEAN and the manifest records ROUND_1_NOT_CLEAN. The Markdown report likewise describes only the earlier unavailable-review attempts. Review state is therefore inconsistent across the checkpoint artifacts.
findings.minimal_fix: Record both states explicitly and consistently: earlier unavailable attempts were NOT_RUN, followed by four round-one NOT_CLEAN reviews; update the progress receipt and Markdown report to match the JSON manifest.

findings.minimal_fix: Publish the corrected checkpoint, update issue #40, resend the current Markdown and JSON to Luke, and commit the new publication commit, issue-comment identifier, message identifier, sizes, and matching SHA-256 hashes.
